steps.what: Read current literature, discuss developments with colleagues and participate in professional conferences

tasks.design: Retain critical reading, professional discussion and conference participation. Literature summaries in {DOCS} may support orientation but do not replace scientific understanding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Learning requires evaluating methods, results and colleagues' reasoning.
tasks.enabler_now: Summary generation does not establish an equivalent learning outcome.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising important methodological changes and weak claims.
tasks.human_edge: Integrate new evidence into teaching and research judgment.

evidence.claim: Scopus AI supplies topic summaries and foundational papers; this does not demonstrate replacement of scientific reading or professional discussion.

assumptions: Boundary is substantive professional learning, excluding separate literature cataloguing.
Authors and colleagues produce source contributions; the lecturer reads and discusses them during s1. No structured importance or truth flag is assumed.
Test existing catalogue tools before additions; no new tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new system or process is added.
research_questions: Which developments require full methodological reading before teaching use?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives zero gross and net. Familiar and unfamiliar topics both retain critical engagement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise students on curricula and careers

steps.what: Advise students on academic and vocational curricula and career issues

tasks.design: Keep individual advice with the lecturer using current curriculum information in {DOCS}. No automated recommendation or presumed application-preparation work is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on goals, constraints and an evolving conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: No verified replacement for this individual guidance is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding uncertainty in a student's plans without narrowing options prematurely.
tasks.human_edge: Listen, challenge assumptions and explain realistic choices.
tasks.altitude: Student advising and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Distinguish formal requirements from personal advice

evidence.claim: General teaching drafting capabilities do not demonstrate replacement of individual career guidance.

assumptions: Boundary is substantive advising, excluding scheduling and official progression decisions.
Student describes goals and constraints during s1; curriculum owner maintains existing information. No structured student suitability or eligibility flag is assumed.
Test current curriculum access before adding tools; no change is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new system or process is introduced.
unknowns: Curriculum options and available specialist referral routes
research_questions: Which student questions require a specialist referral rather than lecturer advice?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross and net zero. Routine and complex student conversations retain human advising.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the research case, methods, resources and grant proposal requirements
Write grant proposal sections from the verified research brief

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory proposal prose from the scientist's case
loop.input: Versioned brief, source passages, budget and call requirements
loop.output: Proposal draft with source references and unresolved items
loop.check: Lecturer checks novelty, claims, methods, citations, resource commitments and consistency with call requirements
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported claims or unclear commitments return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates provide structure but cannot articulate the particular research rationale

steps.what: Check the scientific case and accept the final grant proposal draft

tasks.design: Use the funding template in {DOCS} first, then bounded drafting for narrative sections. The lecturer defines the scientific proposal and accepts the completed draft; institutional approval and submission remain separate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Proposal wording repeats information distributed across scientific and budget notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Source constrained drafting can propose coherent prose without choosing the research case.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining genuine novelty and feasible methods without exaggeration.
tasks.human_edge: Own the scientific argument and commitments.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less narrative drafting; scientific ownership remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep requirements distinct from claims of merit

evidence.claim: EduGenAI provides a general teaching chat platform; grant drafting suitability and time savings are not established by this capability.
The proposed narrative drafting and effort assumptions are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary ends at accepted author draft, excluding institutional commitments, approval and submission.

Lecturer captures call/version, section limits, aims, methods, evidence passages, verified references, resource assumptions and budget figures in s1. Capture remains fully counted; missing facts stay unresolved or are manually supplied.
Test native funding templates first. Only approved environments and permitted source material may be used; confirm funder and institutional drafting conditions before the loop.
No confidential third-party proposal or reviewer material is required; manual drafting remains the fallback if access is unsuitable.
unknowns: Funder drafting policy, institutional access and source confidentiality
research_questions: Does checking a source constrained narrative take less time than writing it manually?

already_counted.description: Scientific case, requirements and budget capture

incremental.description: Maintain call templates and inspect drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact author draft, source versions, call and budget snapshot; any change requires renewed author check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R89.5 gives10.5 gross minus6 upkeep=4.5 net. Novel proposals may need full manual wording; repeated descriptive sections may yield1%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select, order and maintain teaching and research supplies

steps.what: Inspect available supplies and select textbooks, chemicals or laboratory equipment needed
Prepare the order request for selected materials and supplies
Check quantities and specifications and place the authorised supply order
Maintain materials, supplies and laboratory equipment in usable condition

tasks.design: Configure catalogue request generation in the {PROCUREMENT} system. The lecturer still inspects stock, chooses suitable materials, checks the order and maintains physical supplies and equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Order forms repeatedly copy already selected catalogue details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue and request templates can prepare the draft without retyping.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting correct chemical specifications and recognising unusable stock or equipment.
tasks.human_edge: Judge scientific suitability and physical condition.
tasks.altitude: Less order form entry; selection and maintenance remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Verify quantity, specification and physical condition

evidence.claim: Native catalogue request generation is a model knowledge proposal; no supplied chemistry procurement case establishes savings.

assumptions: Boundary is the lecturer's selection, ordering and maintenance work. Purchasing-team approvals, supplier fulfilment and receiving remain unchanged outside this task.

Lecturer captures item id, exact specification/grade or edition, required quantity/unit, observed usable stock, delivery need, cost centre and permitted supplier in s1. Inspection and capture time remain; absent catalogue data require manual request preparation.
No free par level, chemical suitability or stock-available flag is assumed. Catalogue administrator maintains authorised item data; five other-role incremental hours below cover extra maintenance.

Test native PROCUREMENT catalogue and forms first. The assumed lecturer has authority for s3; otherwise route to the existing purchasing approval without claiming that labour as a saving. Physical maintenance in s4 concerns existing items, not future deliveries.
unknowns: Purchasing authority, catalogue coverage and current manual entry effort
research_questions: Can native catalogue requests preserve exact chemical and equipment specifications without extra checking?

already_counted.description: Physical stock check, selection and specification capture

incremental.description: Maintain request mappings and investigate specification mismatches

approvals.approved_version: Exact items, specifications, quantities, supplier, price, delivery need and cost centre; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives20 gross minus7 upkeep=13 net. Existing catalogue automation yields zero; repeat manual form entry may yield3%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Professional learning and advising stay human; grant narrative and supply order entry gain limited support.
reach: Coordinate accurate supply specifications with teaching assistants
role.ambitious_version: A chemistry lecturer who keeps scientific and student decisions human while reducing repeated authoring and entry.
